mapper.select: select * from parent p join parent_student ps on p.parent_no = ps.parent_no where p.account_no = #{accountNo}

select p.parent_no as parentNo, ps.student_no as studentNo, ps.relationship as relationship, a.account_no as accountNo, a.account_id as accountId, a.account_name as accountName, a.account_phone as accountPhone, a.account_status as accountStatus from parent_student ps join parent p on ps.parent_no = p.parent_no join account a on p.account_no = a.account_no where ps.student_no = #{studentNo}

select p.parent_no as parentNo, a.account_no as accountNo, a.account_id as accountId, a.account_name as accountName, a.account_phone as accountPhone from parent p join account a on p.account_no = a.account_no where a.account_name like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or a.account_phone like '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
mapper.update: update account set account_status = 'Y', account_utime = systimestamp where account_no = ( select account_no from parent where parent_no = #{parentNo} )

sql.where:
a.account_type = '학부모'
and a.account_status = 'N'
and a.account_status = 'Y'
and ( a.account_name like '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' or a.account_phone like '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' or a.account_id like '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' or exists ( select 1 from parent_student ps_sub join student s_sub on ps_sub.student_no = s_sub.student_no join account sa_sub on s_sub.account_no = sa_sub.account_no where ps_sub.parent_no = p.parent_no and sa_sub.account_name like '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' ) )

mapper.select: select count(*) from parent p join account a on p.account_no = a.account_no

SELECT p.parent_no, a.account_no, a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_phone, a.account_status, a.account_birth, a.account_utime, a.account_type, ps.student_no, sa.account_name AS student_name, ps.relationship FROM parent p JOIN account a ON p.account_no = a.account_no LEFT JOIN parent_student ps ON p.parent_no = ps.parent_no LEFT JOIN student s ON ps.student_no = s.student_no LEFT JOIN account sa ON s.account_no = sa.account_no WHERE p.parent_no = #{parentNo} ORDER BY ps.student_no ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET account_name = #{accountName}, account_phone = #{accountPhone}, account_birth = #{accountBirth}, account_status = #{accountStatus}, account_utime = systimestamp WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}
